$description: The format menu. To make a piece, name the format here and the correct canvas, lockup, and margins are selected deterministically. Colour and type never change per format.

brand.name: hotelink
brand.display_name_note: Lowercase in the wordmark and in Hotelink's own copy. See qa/FINDINGS.md H-03.
brand.source: hotelink.ai as shipped 2026-10-30. No brand book supplied yet (H-01).

og-1200x630.label: Social share card / link preview
og-1200x630.notes: The one approved reference. No coded template yet: the right-panel system diagram has no approved illustration file (H-07). To make one, reproduce the reference with real tokens, fonts, and logos, and measure it.

card-16x9.label: Title card / presentation ground
card-16x9.notes: Layout follows the left half of the social card (eyebrow, two-beat headline, body, brand tag). Numbers are scaled from the reference, not measured against a 16:9 reference, because none exists.

social-1x1.label: Square social post
social-1x1.notes: The everyday piece. Not measured against a reference (none exists).

sting.label: Motion sting / animated logo
sting.notes: Real mark file, wordmark set as type. No motion reference from Hotelink; the ad's logo moment at 1:36 would be the natural one to measure against.

banner-3x1.label: Wide banner
banner-3x1.notes: PENDING. No reference, no template. If asked for one, say no approved reference exists and ask for one.

colour_usage.$description: Which mark file goes on which ground. Deterministic, so nobody has to guess.

pending_assets: A Hotelink palette/type sheet to confirm the site values (H-01).
A licensed or replacement wordmark face: Georgia is a system font (H-02).
A rail-bar mark file if the dark-header variant is approved (H-06).
The social card's system-diagram illustration as a file (H-07).
Approved references for card-16x9, social-1x1, sting, banner-3x1.
